summary: Brenmiller Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a $1,000,000 subsequent funding tranche under an existing securities purchase agreement with Alpha Capital Anstalt. The company will issue 1,000 preferred shares convertible at $0.9175 per share and warrants to purchase 1,089,918 ordinary shares at $14.56 per share. Closing is expected on or about July 13, 2026. Net proceeds will fund working capital and commercial TES projects. This is a routine at-the-market-like drawdown under a pre-existing facility, not a standalone special situation.
